description: Application for the approval of reserved matters for the development of 210 residential units (Use Class C3) with associated car parking, hard and soft landscaping, public realm, streetscape and associated works pursuant to conditions LCS0.27 and LCS0.28 of outline planning permission 11/90621/OUTODA as varied by 18/00471/VAR being details of layout, scale, appearance, means of access and landscape.
